long_biography.plain_text:
When Fish Farm was established in 2013, Bader Bin Mubarak brought experience from Dubai’s maritime sector to an aquaculture venture. The business aimed to reduce dependence on imported seafood. As chief executive and shareholders’ representative, he oversaw a network spanning a coastal hatchery and cage farms. A Jebel Ali recirculating facility was designed to reproduce freshwater and saltwater conditions for Atlantic salmon.

Bin Mubarak also represented Fish Farm in agreements to operate government hatcheries and support releases of locally important species. The company’s work connected commercial production with the UAE’s broader food-security and fisheries programmes. Beyond aquaculture, he has held leadership roles in shipbuilding and the Dubai Council for Marine and Maritime Industries. These include service as chief executive of Dubai Ship Building and deputy chairman of the industry council.
